tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Huawei eKitEngine S310-24P4S is a powerful L2+ managed switch built to meet the growing demands of enterprise networks, surveillance infrastructure, and smart building deployments. Equipped with 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ ports and 4x Gigabit SFP uplink ports, it ensures high-speed connectivity with robust power delivery.

With a 380W PoE+ power budget, the S310-24P4S supports the IEEE 802.3af/at standard to power a wide variety of devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones, all over a single Ethernet cable.

This switch delivers reliable L2+ switching features such as VLANs, QoS, IGMP snooping, and static routing. It's ideal for businesses, education, hospitality, and surveillance networks in Bangladesh requiring intelligent, secure, and energy-efficient switching.

Key Features:

  • Model: Huawei eKitEngine S310-24P4S

  • Ports:

    • 24 x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ ports

    • 4 x Gigabit SFP uplinks

  • PoE Budget: 380W (supports IEEE 802.3af/at)

  • Switching Capacity: High-performance non-blocking switching

  • Management: Web UI, CLI, SNMP, Telnet, Huawei eSight support

  • L2+ Features:

    • VLAN, ACL, QoS

    • IGMP Snooping

    • Static Routing

    • STP/RSTP/MSTP

    • Link Aggregation (LACP)

  • Reliability: Fan-cooled, rackmount ready, enhanced surge protection

  • Deployment: Plug-and-play with centralized monitoring options


Use Case Scenarios:

  • Corporate office networks

  • IP surveillance deployments

  • VoIP-enabled business systems

  • Wi-Fi access point backbone

  • Smart classrooms and smart buildings
